items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: It was Jack Teagarden, Earl Hines were heading the group, was Peanuts Hucko; Max Kaminsky; Jack Lesberg and me.

ctx.x: There's a few things-scattered in here in between. It says, Autum of '57 you toured Europe with 'All Stars' led by Jack Teagarden and Earl Hines.

That's a little tour I took with them, just me myself, it was an all-star group. It was Jack Teagarden, Earl Hines were heading the group, was Peanuts Hucko; Max Kaminsky; Jack Lesberg and me. We did about 18 days over in Europe, but it was headed by Jack Teagarden and Earl Hines.
I assume it went over very well.
